scope: Requested-date triage, audited employee follow-ups and P&C acknowledgement using existing HR Service Desk records; integrated policy guidance and privacy regression.
changes: Existing needed-by dates are labelled requested dates, not institutional SLA commitments. Open requests past the requested date and requests due today are counted in Malaysia time.

An active requesting employee can follow up after their requested date. One pending follow-up is allowed until P&C acknowledges it. Both actions retain request status, existing approvals, drafts and files.

Follow-up and acknowledgement signals are ordered by request version in existing append-only events, independently of timestamp ties or UUID order. No database migration or duplicate employee/request store.

New employee writes recheck active lifecycle eligibility, identity/account linkage and unique active email within the atomic request mutation. Conflicts retain existing records and emit no false follow-up.
The P&C queue prioritises pending follow-ups and past requested dates before its 500-row display limit; summary totals cover all scoped requests.
Homepage adds employee requests needing information and P&C-only aggregate follow-up/requested-date counts. Confidential case details and request content are excluded.
Policy library links to the existing authenticated HR query form; the service desk links back to policies and guides claim enquiries to the existing Benefits / payroll query type.
Acknowledgement UI requires saving unsaved draft changes first. Existing private draft/file release and payroll/payment approvals are preserved.
